intended_object: A precomputed rational interval (bounds of about 0.99518 and 0.99729) enclosing a sine value for cell 60 of a computer-assisted verification of Gerver's sofa. It is used as cached certificate data so that kernel reduction can be shared. This is inferred from the docstring, the name and the module location (KernelOnly/Core/Bundle003).
explanation: The definition is a hard-coded pair of rational numbers, built from big-number chunks, that gives a numerical enclosure for one cell of a kernel-checked interval-arithmetic proof. It is an implementation detail of the proof: cached data meant to speed up kernel reduction, with no counterpart in the mathematical literature. Whether it is correct (whether it really encloses the relevant sine values) is something the proofs that use it would check. It is not something to compare against a standard mathematical definition.
